description: Change the Shelly integration; every change is saved (sh_save). action: enable (enabled=true|false), add (ip), add_found (index from the scan), scan (start=true|false), delete / probe / push (device), disable (device, disabled), rename (device, name), poll (device, ms 500..60000), auth (device, user, password), bind_output (device, channel, output_id: the Shelly channel follows that myIO output; 0 = unbind), bind_input (device, channel, button 1..SQ, mode 0 button / 1 toggle / 2 hit-only), bind_sensor (device, slot 0..3, metric 1 temp / 2 hum / 3 power / 4 volt / 5 curr / 6 energy / 7 device temp, channel, usens id; usens 0 = unbind). After input / sensor bindings send action=push so the Shelly calls back. Device = slot number from myio_shelly. Editor/admin level.
name: myio_shelly_set
title: Configure Shelly
